product_scope: Commercial public-influence and media-intelligence research. No provider is connected.

providers.authentication: Server-side API key for public resources; OAuth is required for user-authorized resources.
known_constraints: videos.list has a documented quota cost of one unit per call; the default allocation includes 100 search.list calls per day and 10,000 units per day for other methods.
Public view counts are cumulative platform counters, not unique reach, audience demographics or proof of sponsorship.
Search pagination consumes additional quota; cache results and monitor project quota.
Collection and display must comply with YouTube API Services Terms and Developer Policies.

providers.authentication: OAuth 2.0 authorization by the channel owner; content-owner reports require eligible YouTube content-partner access.
known_constraints: The authorizing user must own the requested channel; channel==MINE refers to the authenticated user's channel.
This cannot provide private analytics for an unrelated influencer without that creator's authorization.
Content-owner reports are limited to YouTube content partners.

official_sources.title: YouTube Analytics API — Content Owner Reports

providers.authentication: Developer app credentials and server-side bearer-token authentication; credentials must never enter browser code.
known_constraints: Official pricing reviewed 28 November 2026 lists USD 0.005 per post read, USD 0.010 per user read and USD 0.010 per Trends request; rates can change.
Pay-per-use credits must be purchased before requests; no subscription or minimum spend is stated on the reviewed pricing page.
The pay-per-use plan is capped at 3 million post reads per monthly billing cycle before Enterprise access is needed.
No credits, payment method, auto-recharge or API app has been configured. Require an explicit spend ceiling and disabled auto-recharge before any pilot.
X trends and post search are X-specific signals, not a complete measure of Argentine public opinion or cross-platform hashtag volume.

X API — Pay-per-usage pricing and credits

providers.product_name: Consumer Research API and Developer APIs
providers.authentication: Vendor-provisioned API user credentials and bearer token; documented API access requires a Regular or Admin user.
known_constraints: Public documentation does not establish Vilanova access, data coverage, price or contract rights.
The documented Consumer Research API client limit is 30 calls per 10 minutes; account-specific limits must be confirmed.
Brandwatch states that X mentions may have full text and most metadata stripped; online news and LinkedIn are also listed among sources that may be affected.
A vendor discovery call and written coverage, retention, export, redistribution, SLA and price terms are required before selection.

providers.authentication: No API key is required for the documented DOC 2.0 query endpoint.
known_constraints: This is an online-news source, not a social-post, hashtag-volume, influencer-reach or sponsorship API.
DOC 2.0 article-list search covers a rolling three-month window; timeline modes have different historical coverage.
The project rate-limits requests. Implement caching, conservative polling, content-type checks and backoff on HTTP 429.
Coverage volume measures monitored news coverage, not population opinion or the total number of people discussing a topic.

providers.authentication: Research Tools application, approved research project and controlled access; a developer account alone is insufficient.
known_constraints: TikTok's current Research Tools FAQ explicitly says creators, advertisers and commercial users are not eligible.
Published eligibility focuses on qualified academic and non-profit research in specified regions; Argentina is not listed on the reviewed eligibility page.
Do not use this research-only route as the data source for a commercial Influence Radar product.

providers.authentication: Application through Research Tools Manager and approved access in Meta Secure Research Environment or an approved cleanroom.
known_constraints: Eligibility requires affiliation with a qualified academic institution or a qualified non-academic not-for-profit research institution.
Access is application-controlled and uses a secure research environment.
Meta states there is no fee for eligible Secure Research Environment access, but free access does not remove eligibility, contractual, security or publication restrictions.
This is not a general commercial social-listening feed for Vilanova.

providers.provider_name: Public primary sources and publisher records
providers.authentication: No platform credentials; each source is opened, dated, attributed and reviewed by a human researcher.
known_constraints: Manual review is required to attribute a statement, distinguish sponsorship from endorsement and assess whether a relationship remains current.
Public availability does not automatically grant republication rights; preserve short factual extracts, citations and source-specific reuse restrictions.
A source URL alone is not proof that the underlying claim is true; record the exact passage, date and reviewer decision.
